title: Variables, Outputs & Types
summary: Make configurations reusable and safe: typed input variables with validation, the ways to set them and their precedence, locals, outputs, data sources and `terraform console` for experimenting.
objectives: Declare input variables with precise types, including objects with `optional()` attributes and defaults
Write `validation` blocks with clear error messages and use `sensitive`, `nullable` and `ephemeral` correctly
Set variables via `terraform.tfvars`, `*.auto.tfvars`, `-var`, `-var-file` and `TF_VAR_` and predict which value wins
Use locals to name and reuse derived values without turning them into inputs
Expose outputs (including sensitive ones) and consume them from the CLI and scripts
Read existing information with data sources and experiment with expressions in `terraform console`
